Body.Content:
Procurement teams can apply supplier charges, such as freight, handling or surcharges, consistently, without setting them up manually on each purchase order. With this feature, pricing managers can use unified pricing management to define procurement charges based on attributes. Purchase orders then pick up the right charges automatically.

GA date: June CY2027

Preview date: April CY2027
